notes.content:
[h3]Here are 10 more previews from our upcoming release of [i]Seducing The Devil[/i].
Version 0.13 was our biggest update so far with over 2,100 renders and more than 50 animations across four paths.
Version 0.14 already has 2,000 renders and 80+ animations in just the two UK paths alone. Once the two US paths are added, the total will reach more than 3,500 renders and 120+ animations. This is going to be our biggest update ever.[/h3][h3]As we move closer to the end, we are ramping up the number of renders and animations. All the bad paths will conclude in this update, while the good paths will take two more updates to finish.[/h3][h3]We have one question. notes.title: Feedback & Next Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!
We hope you're enjoying the new update. We worked really hard on it, and personally, we think it turned out great. But what truly matters is your opinion.
Please let us know what you think of the update!

Also, if you have a moment, please consider leaving a review on the game’s page. It really helps us get discovered by other players. As many of you know, developing this game is a full-time job for us, and in order to continue working on it — as well as future titles — we need to maintain steady sales.

Your review could help us get recommended to many more players.

As for version 0.14 — we haven’t started working on it just yet.
We're currently wrapping up the update for our second game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543770/It_Was_Raining_That_Night/]It Was Raining That Night[/url], which should be completed in a few days.
After that, we’ll be taking a short break — about a week — to clear our minds before jumping back into development.[/h2]

notes.title: Seducing The Devil - Turkish Added
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515342/69eea99890d9b857512661b89ee1e408711ab2d8.png[/img]

[h2]I’m excited to announce that the game now includes Turkish as a playable language!

The translation was done using machine translation. If you notice any issues or errors, please don’t hesitate to let me know so I can address them promptly.

All dialogues and menu buttons have been translated. You can seamlessly switch between Turkish, Chinese, German, Portuguese, French, and English at any time without affecting your game progress. The language can be changed from both the main menu and the preferences menu.

Please note that many dialogues include English names, such as Dad, Mom, Adam, Rachel, Aunt Diana, and Cherry, which will remain unchanged. Additionally, the episode titles and the game’s name in the main menu will also remain in English.

I hope our Turkish players will enjoy the game even more with this update!


Oyun artık Türkçe dil seçeneğiyle oynanabilir!

Çeviri, makine çevirisi kullanılarak yapıldı. Eğer herhangi bir sorun veya hata fark ederseniz, lütfen bana bildirin ki düzeltmeler yapabileyim.

Tüm diyaloglar ve menü düğmeleri Türkçeye çevrildi. Oyununuzu kaydetmeden veya ilerlemenizi etkilemeden Türkçe, Çince, Almanca, Portekizce, Fransızca ve İngilizce arasında kolayca geçiş yapabilirsiniz. Dil seçeneğini hem ana menüden hem de tercihler menüsünden değiştirebilirsiniz.

Lütfen unutmayın: Diyaloglarda geçen Baba, Anne, Adam, Rachel, Diana Teyze ve Cherry gibi İngilizce isimler değişmeden kalacaktır. Ayrıca, bölüm başlıkları ve ana menüdeki oyun adı da İngilizce olarak kalacaktır.

Bu güncelleme ile Türk oyuncularımızın oyundan daha fazla keyif alacağını umuyorum![/h2]


[h1]The next language to be added is Russian. And then Spanish, Italian, and Japanese.[/h1]

notes.title: Seducing The Devil (0.12b) Release & Major life Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515342/a9e8f9b6999f352c83d629e8e7773f0f323091c3.png[/img]

The second part of 0.12 is here. This time we are continuing the Ella Only (USA) route.

*****************************************

[b]What's new:[/b]

# 7 playable scenes with multiple branches
# 321 new renders
# 7 new animations


*****************************************

[b]Where are the translations and music?[/b]


In the coming days- French, Portuguese, German & Chinese language will be added to the game. They are in their final stages of being completed. I've added a few music to the game. Expect more to be added in the coming days.


******************************************

[b]Why the massive delay?[/b]

I know that the majority of you are disappointed with the update schedule and me going MIA for a very long time. You must have noticed that I wasn't even present in my socials where I promote my game and share special content. Twitter, Reddit, and Discord are my main platforms to market the game and I wasn't there at all for the most part of last year. 

There are two different but big reasons behind that.

The first one was a legal reason. I can't fully explain what the legal reason was. But that stopped me from working for many many months. We had to seek legal counselling and help to get past that situation. Basically, we were being blackmailed by an individual. And that whole situation took a huge toll on us. We had to move multiple times since we feared for our lives at one point.

Now the second reason and it's the bigger one. Last year, at the end of July, I was beaten to a pulp by a certain individual that I do not wish to name. The aftermath was concussion due to several head traumas, and severe blurry and flashy visions. I thought that was it. But what started happening since that day is what stopped me from being able to work. I have severe memory loss problems. I'm showing signs of dementia. I forget a lot of things and I've forgotten a lot of things about my game. I can't focus because I would constantly forget what I'm doing. I don't have the game written in a script form. Everything is in my head and I work that way. And for that reason, for the past 1 year, I haven't been able to work at all. This update is short and it's for a reason. Thanks to my partner, I could at least finish this one. 

For the past 5 months, I've searched a lot for employees to work on my game instead of me. And I'm glad to let you know that I have found 3 fine individuals to work with me remotely from now on. The update schedule will get better from now and there will not be any pauses like last before as long as I'm fine. 
The story, as planned from the early days, might get changed due to this new approach. As mentioned already, I have forgotten many things and it's tough for me to try to remember them. 

I'm sorry to disappoint you all. But this journey has never been easy for us. Our Patreon and Discord followers know it all too well. 

I'll make sure that this game sees its ending like it deserves. And it will be a glorious ending. 

Cheers
Deafperv


P.S - Don't forget to put my wife's game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543770/It_Was_Raining_That_Night/]"It Was Raining That Night"[/url] on your wishlist

(Please don't to forget review this game if you haven't yet)
